title.narrative: Acon Latin America Opportunities Fund VI-A, L.P.

description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to equity for mid-market companies, primarily in Brazil, the Andean region and Mexico, and, opportunistically, in other Latin American countries (LAC). Moreover, the Fund will also support inclusion in the LAC private equity market by committing to allocating capital to women-owned/led companies. Beyond the project, the Funds success will also help increase competition in the market, given the decrease in both private equity fundraising and activity in the LAC region, outside Brazil.

The proposed investment is for up to US$25 million, capped at 20% of aggregate capital commitments, along with a discretionary co-investment envelope of up to US$20 million, into ACON Latin America Opportunities Fund VI-A, L.P. (collectively with ACON Latin America Opportunities Fund VI, L.P. (, the Fund). The Fund will invest in equity and structured capital transactions in mid-market companies across Latin America, with a primary focus on Brazil, the Andean region and Mexico. Investment amounts are generally expected to range from US$30 million to US$100 million per transaction and are expected to be aligned with the following themes: (i) household consumption, (ii) healthcare and wellness, (iii) climate, energy transition and connectivity, (iv) financial services, and (v) exporters. The Fund is managed by ACON LatAm Management, L.L.C., an affiliate of ACON Investments, L.L.C. (ACON).
